name: buttons-vscode
description: Scan your project's scripts - package.json, Cargo.toml, go.mod, Makefile, composer.json, justfile, shell, and Python files - into a clickable command launcher. Pick the directories to scan, run, copy, and manage commands in VS Code.

buttons.textSize.description: Text size used in the Buttons UI.

enumDescriptions: Python entry files (app.py, main.py, ...) and venv buttons

buttons.scriptFiles.description: Script file types to scan for runnable commands. shell covers .sh files; python covers Python entry files and venv buttons; Cargo.toml and go.mod offer build/test/run.

path.description: Workspace-relative or absolute directory path. Absolute paths may point outside the workspace.

buttons.scanDirectories.description: Extra directories to scan for scripts. The project root is always scanned at its top level. Paths outside the workspace must be absolute.

buttons.colors.runBackground.description: Background color for the Run button. Empty falls back to actionBackground.

buttons.colors.runForeground.description: Text color for the Run button. Empty falls back to actionForeground.

buttons.colors.newTerminalBackground.description: Background color for the New Terminal button. Empty falls back to actionBackground.

buttons.colors.newTerminalForeground.description: Text color for the New Terminal button. Empty falls back to actionForeground.

buttons.colors.appendBackground.description: Background color for the + (append with space) button. Empty falls back to actionBackground.

buttons.colors.appendForeground.description: Text color for the + button. Empty falls back to actionForeground.

buttons.colors.newlineBackground.description: Background color for the ↵ (append newline) button. Empty falls back to actionBackground.

buttons.colors.newlineForeground.description: Text color for the ↵ button. Empty falls back to actionForeground.

buttons.colors.copyBackground.description: Background color for the Copy button. Empty falls back to actionBackground.

buttons.colors.copyForeground.description: Text color for the Copy button. Empty falls back to actionForeground.

buttons.colors.duplicateBackground.description: Background color for the Duplicate button. Empty falls back to actionBackground.

buttons.colors.duplicateForeground.description: Text color for the Duplicate button. Empty falls back to actionForeground.

buttons.colors.editBackground.description: Background color for the Note/Edit button. Empty falls back to actionBackground.

buttons.colors.editForeground.description: Text color for the Note/Edit button. Empty falls back to actionForeground.

buttons.colors.removeBackground.description: Background color for the ✕ remove button. Empty falls back to actionBackground.

buttons.colors.removeForeground.description: Text color for the ✕ remove button. Empty falls back to actionForeground.

buttons.colors.actionBackground.description: Fallback background for action buttons and fill for header actions (Generate, Rescan, Add command). Per-button colors override this.

buttons.colors.actionForeground.description: Fallback text color for action buttons and header actions. Per-button colors override this.

buttons.colors.commandForeground.description: Color of command text. Empty inherits the editor foreground.

buttons.colors.commandBackground.description: Background color behind command text. Empty is transparent.

buttons.colors.variantCommandForeground.description: Color of variant command text. Empty falls back to commandForeground.

buttons.colors.variantCommandBackground.description: Background color behind variant command text. Empty falls back to commandBackground.

buttons.colors.rowBackground.description: Fallback background for command cards and table rows. Empty is transparent.

buttons.colors.rowOddBackground.description: Background for odd command rows. Empty falls back to rowBackground.

buttons.colors.rowEvenBackground.description: Background for even command rows. Empty falls back to rowBackground.

buttons.colors.variantRowBackground.description: Fallback background for variant rows. Empty falls back to rowBackground.

buttons.colors.variantRowOddBackground.description: Background for odd variant rows. Empty falls back to variantRowBackground.

buttons.colors.variantRowEvenBackground.description: Background for even variant rows. Empty falls back to variantRowBackground.

buttons.colors.background.description: Deprecated. Used as a fallback for action and row background when the dedicated settings are empty.

buttons.colors.foreground.description: Deprecated. Used as a fallback for action and command text when the dedicated settings are empty.

buttons.colors.hoverBackground.description: Hover background for action buttons. Leave empty to inherit the VS Code button theme.
